seo_title: Deputy vs Tanda: Australian Payroll & Compliance Audit (2026)
meta_description: Technical comparison of Deputy and Tanda for Australian Fair Work compliance, Xero integration, and workforce management architecture.
direct_verdict: Deputy is the superior choice for high-growth businesses requiring robust API extensibility and global scalability. Tanda offers a more cohesive, single-stack experience for Australian-only SMBs prioritizing tight payroll-to-roster integration.
product_a_pros: Extensive REST API for custom enterprise integrations
Transparent pricing with clear minimums and add-on costs
product_a_cons: SMS costs can scale rapidly for large, mobile-first teams
Complex configuration required for advanced Award interpretation
product_b_pros: True all-in-one payroll and rostering reduces sync errors
product_b_cons: Opaque pricing structure requires sales contact
Limited ecosystem flexibility compared to Deputy
hidden_gotchas: Deputy enforces a $30 AUD minimum monthly spend regardless of user count, which penalizes very small teams. Furthermore, Deputy charges for every user in the system, including archived users if they are not managed correctly, leading to billing bloat. Tanda's all-in-one pricing appears competitive but lacks the granular API documentation needed for custom ERP middleware, potentially forcing a total platform migration if your business requirements outgrow their native feature set.
